read_pipeline_code: read pipeline script from config or workdir and return its source code as a string
compare_value: compare metric values from a metrics dictionary and return the best metric name and value
is_headspace_entry: check if a workflow entry dict is a headspace or cache entry by inspecting its name field
current_best_metric: find the best step time or duration metric from a state history list of entries
refactor_compare_value: refactor the _compare_value function to support additional metric comparison strategies beyond the policy module
